basics.name: Njenga Kariuki
basics.label: Managing Executive: AI, M-PESA Africa (Vodacom FinTech Group) | Former Amazon & AWS AI Product Executive
basics.summary: AI executive leading enterprise AI transformation across Vodacom FinTech Group, including M-PESA Africa (100M+ customers across eight African markets and $2B+ revenue), reporting to the CEO and building the AI Center of Excellence. Previously spent 12 years in the United States at Amazon and AWS building and scaling AI-native businesses and products from zero to one across software, hardware, and mobile applications spanning e-commerce, IoT, connected devices, supply chain, health, and life sciences. Led large-scale science, engineering, and product organizations of 100+, directed $100M+ AI portfolios and businesses up to $700M, and delivered frontier machine learning, computer vision, and LLM capabilities at global scale, most recently leading product for Amazon Bio Discovery, an agentic AI platform for drug discovery. Holds a Master of Science in Management from Stanford Graduate School of Business, published research on AI's global economic impact at the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (Stanford HAI, AI Index Report 2025), and is a named inventor on six granted U.S. patents.

work.name: M-PESA Africa (Vodacom FinTech Group)
work.location: Nairobi, Kenya (8 African markets: Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, DRC, Mozambique, Lesotho, South Africa, Egypt)
work.summary: Leads enterprise AI strategy, roadmap, and the AI Center of Excellence across Vodacom FinTech Group and M-PESA Africa, reporting to the CEO.
highlights: Owns the AI roadmap across 100M+ customers, eight African markets, and $2B+ revenue covering customer experience, revenue growth, risk, fraud, and operational efficiency.
Moves enterprise AI from isolated single-function tasks (units of work) to cross-functional workflows redesigned end to end (systems of work), measured against comparison groups.
Establishes shared AI governance standards with legal, risk, and compliance sign-off while building first production systems hands-on with market teams.

work.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS): Applied AI, Life Sciences
work.position: Head of Product, Amazon Bio Discovery
work.summary: Led product for Amazon Bio Discovery, an agentic AI application for antibody design, from inception to general launch on 14 April 2026.
highlights: Directed a cross-functional organization of 100+ engineers, scientists, and product managers.
Launched with AI agents, 40+ biological AI models, and integrated partner wet-lab ordering; Memorial Sloan Kettering went from target to lab order in weeks rather than 6-12 months.
Early adopters included Memorial Sloan Kettering, Bayer, Broad Institute, Fred Hutch Cancer Center, Voyager Therapeutics, and Novo Nordisk.

work.name: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI)
work.position: Graduate Researcher & Economy Chapter Author (AI Index Report 2025)
work.summary: Authored the text and economic analysis of Chapter 4 (Economy) of Stanford HAI's AI Index Report 2025.
highlights: Published 7 April 2025 (77 pages, 89 figures across five data layers: investment, job postings, hiring, enterprise adoption, and industrial robots).
Cited by the U.S. Federal Reserve Board (October 2025) and the White House Council of Economic Advisers (January 2026).

work.name: Amazon: Alexa Smart Home & Map View
work.summary: Led smart home product experiences for the Alexa app (50M+ monthly users) and served as Technical Advisor and Chief of Staff to the VP of Amazon Smart Home and Health.
highlights: Launched Alexa Map View in the United States (November 2023), turning LiDAR phone scans into interactive smart-home floor plans.

work.name: Amazon: Health Computer Vision & AI
work.summary: First product lead of Amazon's Health Computer Vision and AI organization (100+ scientists and engineers).
highlights: Directed a $100M+/year AI R&D and product investment portfolio and managed 10 product managers.
Three computer vision health products validated in peer-reviewed studies in npj Digital Medicine (2022, 2022, 2023).

work.name: Amazon: Amazon Halo (Founding Team)
work.summary: Founding product lead for Amazon Halo Body, Halo Tone, and Halo Movement from concept through launch.
highlights: Shipped Halo Body and Halo Tone (August 2020) and Halo Movement (June 2021).
Named inventor on six granted U.S. patents from Halo Tone voice AI work.

work.name: Amazon: Alexa Shopping
work.summary: First product lead for Alexa voice shopping NLU; built and led a 10-person evaluation team.
highlights: Increased voice shopping request accuracy from ~50% to 85%.

work.name: Amazon: Prime Now

work.summary: Founding product manager for Prime Now's local-store catalog, forecasting, and seller onboarding platform across 7 countries.
highlights: Reduced partner store out-of-stock rate from 25% to 5% and automated 40 hours/week of manual inventory operations.

work.name: Amazon: Bedding & Bath

work.name: Target Corporation

highlights: Improved in-stock rate by 24% and grew market share by 3%; led store allocation for the November 2012 iPad mini launch.
